crew.overview: A reforming ex-gangster tries to reconcile with his estranged policeman brother, but the ties to his former gang are difficult to break.
crew.title: A Better Tomorrow

details.biography:
Chan Hing-Kai is a writer-director and producer from Hong Kong. His screenwriting works include Heart to Hearts (1988), A Better Tomorrow (1986), Beast Cops (1998); and he directed and wrote La Brasserie (2001). In recent years, he has also served as a producer for First Feature Film Initiative projects such as Weeds on Fire (2016) and My Prince Edward (2019).

He is also a part-time lecturer at The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Baptist University, teaching courses on screenwriting and production.
details.name: Chan Hing-Kai
details.place_of_birth: Hong Kong, British Crown Colony [now China]
